$comment: Single source of truth for the visual system. Emitted as CSS custom properties for the web app and as JSON for the video and social pipelines, so all three channels are literally the same numbers. Never hard-code a hex in a component. Every contrast claim in docs/BRAND.md is verified by scripts/contrast.mjs.

meta.name: We Hate Fast Food
meta.tagline: What's actually in it — and why they put it there.

ink.note: Near-black. Type on paper, the dark ground, the patty band, the slash.

paper.note: Warm beige. The website ground, the heart fill, type on the dark ground.

pink.note: Brand accent. On ink it is body text (5.15:1). On paper it is a pointer only (3.24:1) - fill, never ink, at body size.

muted.note: Derived. Secondary text and hairlines on paper, 6.52:1. The two brand greys do not reach AA on paper.

grey-light.note: Brand grey. Secondary text on ink (8.84:1). On paper it is 1.88:1 - decorative only, never text.

grey-dark.note: Brand grey. Struck-out LOVE on the ink ground, 4.99:1.

tl-high.note: FSA HIGH. Takes paper text at 5.51:1. Chosen by worst-case CIEDE2000 across normal and dichromat vision (scripts/color-separation.mjs), NOT by contrast ratio - see docs/BRAND.md. The previous #7A1410 measured dE 0.8 against ink under protanopia, i.e. the same colour to that reader.

tl-med.note: FSA MEDIUM. Takes ink text - paper text on it is 1.86:1 and fails.

angle-strike.note: The angle of the slash in the mark and of the banner bands. One angle, used everywhere: dividers, band edges, the Specimen Card cut.

hairline.note: Chip and card borders. Boundaries never depend on fill contrast alone.

display.value: Archivo Variable, Archivo, Arial Black, sans-serif
display.note: Headings and the wordmark. Narrow width axis, weight 900 at wordmark size.

body.value: Public Sans Variable, Public Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

data.note: Every numeral, E-number, date, specimen ID and threshold. Tabular figures.

sugar-cube-g.note: Grams of sugar per drawn cube.

salt-tsp-g.note: Grams of salt per drawn level teaspoon.

sat-fat-pat-g.note: Grams of saturated fat per drawn butter pat.

salt-to-sodium-mg.note: EU FIC regulatory convention: salt = sodium x 2.5, so sodium_mg = salt_g x 400. The chemical ratio is 393.4. We use the regulatory constant and say so on the page.
